Rezky Amaliah served as General Secretary (Sekretaris Umum) of COCONUT Computer Club in 2025. She is an Informatics student at Universitas Muhammadiyah Makassar, interested in frontend development and the world of financial engineering. She is currently working on the VulneraX project.
